subject.title: fix(transcript): keep pagination cursors out of secret masking on resume

question: Should OpenClaw permit raw opaque pagination continuation values in persisted, model-visible transcripts, or require a replay-safe representation that preserves the redaction boundary?
rationale: The correct tradeoff is a product and security contract choice: the branch improves resume continuity but weakens an intentional generic key-based redaction rule for values whose sensitivity cannot be inferred safely from the field name.

options.title: Use replay-safe continuation handling
options.body: Keep key-based transcript masking and introduce a machine-detectable marker or owner-controlled token re-resolution path for resumed tool calls.

options.title: Accept the cursor allowlist
options.body: Explicitly accept raw persistence of matching page cursor values and document the resulting transcript sensitivity contract.

recommendation.title: Use replay-safe continuation handling
recommendation.body: Keep key-based transcript masking and introduce a machine-detectable marker or owner-controlled token re-resolution path for resumed tool calls.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent direct review and test work on the proposed transcript-redaction change makes this the strongest available routing signal.
